61823335: This line is getting patient information and storing it into the VAUTNI variable.
30ba208f: Quit the current execution.

7e18c80e: This block of code selects a physician by allowing the user to lookup and select from a list of physicians in the VA(200 file. It sets DGJFL=1 if the user does not select a physician (Y=-1), and then quits if DGJFL is set.
54f42c73: Quit the current execution.
225a8036: This line prompts the user to enter a start date and stores it in DGJTBG and DGJTBEG. It quits if the user enters an up-arrow or null value.

9d0f7d7e: This line prompts the user to enter an end date. If the user enters an up-arrow or null value, it quits. If the entered date is invalid, it calls HELP^%DTC to provide help on entering a valid date.
709a8d3f: This line sets DGJTEND to the end date plus 0.9999 to include the entire end day.
4f7dd7f0: This line checks if the end date is before the start date. If so, it displays an error message and goes back to the END label to re-prompt for the end date.
2b582138: Quit the current execution.
cdb9a356: This block of code allows the user to select a service from the DG(393.1 file. It stores the selected service in Y. If the user does not select a service (Y=-1), it quits.
4fb9dc22: This line allows the user to select a specialty from the DIC(45.7 file and stores the selected specialty in Y.
230a56ac: Quit the current execution.
bad7c059: This line creates a new local variable X to use in the function.
d88060af: This line checks if the 6th piece of DGJTNODE is null. If so, it returns 1 as the record type.
dda8adc0: This line sets X to the 6th piece of DGJTNODE.
54ae8a69: This line sets X to the 12th piece of the DT node for the record type in file 40.8, using the value stored in the previous line.
1354a467: This line sets X to 1 if it is currently null.
667dbee7: This line returns the value stored in X, which represents the record type.
